description: Folder pane verbs. The script loads when the first verb is called.

functions.name: fold
functions.description: Opens or closes the selected folder row (row), every folder row (all), or closes the selected folder or else its parent and selects that (parent). Answers false, with nothing done, unless the folder pane has the focus.

functions.name: focused
functions.description: Answers whether the folder pane has the focus.

functions.name: viewRowCount
functions.description: Answers how many rows the message list shows now. A closed thread counts its root only.

functions.name: viewFindRow
functions.description: Walks the message list from row from, forward or back, and answers {index, id}: the index and message id of the wanted-th row with the flag (unread, flagged or attachment), else of the last such row found, else index -1 and id null.

functions.name: indexFolder
functions.description: Builds the summary file of a local folder that has none or an old one, without showing the folder, and answers true when the parse finished. Answers false, with nothing parsed, for a folder that is not local, and false when the parse takes longer than 30 seconds.
